types.name: DeviceScalar
types.comment: One control of an input device (a stick axis, an analogue or a digital button). InitializeDeviceScalar(DeviceScalarType, char *, ...) at 0x50ba0.

fields.name: type
fields.comment: DeviceScalarType: 0 stick axis, 1 analogue button, 2 digital button

fields.name: previous
fields.comment: last frame's value, in the device's previous array

fields.name: current
fields.comment: this frame's value, in the device's current array

fields.name: extra1
fields.comment: name invented: third per-device array, zeroed and not read by the pad device

types.name: InputDevice
types.comment: Base of the input devices (vtable 0x18d9fc; XBoxPadDevice on Xbox). The derived class points the arrays at its own storage.

fields.name: port
fields.comment: the constructor's argument; PollDevice reads PAD_getdataptr(port)

types.name: XBoxPadDevice
types.comment: An Xbox gamepad as an InputDevice: 20 DeviceScalars (4 stick axes, 8 analogue buttons, 8 digital) and their value arrays. vtable 0x18db38.

types.name: PadData
types.comment: NAME INVENTED: one pad's record in EA's input library, four at 0x241c50 (PAD_getdataptr), filled by PAD_update.

fields.name: analog
fields.comment: A, B, X, Y, black, white, left trigger, right trigger (0..255)

fields.name: buttonsPressed
fields.comment: buttons down this poll and not the last

fields.name: analogPressed
fields.comment: 1 when the analogue button went above 1 this poll

fields.name: unknown6a
fields.comment: zeroed when the pad is removed

fields.name: unknown6c
fields.comment: zeroed when the pad is removed
